about_the_game:
Overview

Skyborne Chronicles is a city-building, resource management survival game set in an alternate post World War I timeline. Your mission: manage a flying city, keep it airborne, and ensure humanity’s survival for 100 years.

In this reimagined history, the Great War dragged on into the 1960s. Both sides unleashed nuclear weapons, rendering the Earth’s surface uninhabitable. Now, the remnants of humanity have ascended to the skies, clinging to survival until the radiation below finally fades.

Core Gameplay

  • Population Management – Assign workers to repair systems, cure illnesses, and keep the city alive.

  • City Expansion – Gather resources to build new districts and improve your city’s resilience.

  • Defense & Survival – Protect your people from rival sky-cities and unexpected disasters.

  • Long-Term Challenge – Balance resources and strategy to keep your city aloft for a full century.

content_descriptors.notes: The mature content in our game revolves around the depiction of a post war society. There is no explicit violence depicted, however, the game does have cannons which the player can shoot. The targets of those cannons, however, are not depicted on screen. The only other mature content revolves around the events that the player faces. For example, a text based explanation that there is a epidemic in the city, or that the citizens started to riot. Again, these events are text based and are not shown explicitly.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-650 or AMD Athlon II X4 650 equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1 GB), AMD Radeon HD 6990 (2 GB), or Intel Arc A310 (4 GB) with latest Mesa/NVIDIA drivers

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1 GB), AMD Radeon HD 6990 (2 GB), or Intel Arc A310 (4 GB) with latest Mesa/NVIDIA drivers
